name: SAPConcurHttpRequest
label: SAP Concur HTTP Request
description: Perform custom HTTP requests to SAP Concur using existing connector and connection.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID from SAP Concur App Management.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret from SAP Concur App Management.

fields.name: HttpMethod
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: The HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

selectOptions.label: GET
selectOptions.description: Retrieves data from the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: POST
selectOptions.description: Submits data to be processed to the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: PUT
selectOptions.description: Updates a current resource with new data.

selectOptions.label: PATCH
selectOptions.description: Applies partial modifications to a resource.

fields.name: JsonPayload
fields.label: JSON Payload
fields.description: Body for POST/PUT requests (leave empty for GET/DELETE).

fields.name: FileBytes
fields.label: File Bytes
fields.description: Optional file bytes for multipart upload (e.g., receipt).

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: Name of the file (e.g., receipt.jpg). Required if File Bytes is provided.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: MIME type of file (e.g., image/jpeg). Default: image/jpeg.

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on Error
fields.description: If true, workflow continues even if the request fails.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: Raw response body from SAP Concur.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.label: Status Code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the API.
